name: 小说管理工具
examples_zh: 在终端里为我的小说项目新增10个章节条目，并把每章关联到对应角色和情节线
搜索所有包含"失踪王子"伏笔的章节和角色记录，整理成时间线
导出当前小说的角色表、章节摘要和未解决情节线，方便我做修订
examples_en: Add 10 chapter records to my novel project from the terminal and link each one to its characters and plotlines
Search all chapter and character records containing the 'missing prince' foreshadowing and organize them into a timeline
Export the current novel's character table, chapter summaries, and unresolved plotlines for revision
description_zh: 在终端管理小说数据(章节、角色、情节)，支持导出和搜索
description_en: Manage novel data (chapters, characters, plots) from terminal with export and search
